rule: Ajanlar once ElevenLabs ile konuya uygun enstrumantal uretir. ElevenLabs baglanti hatasi verirse, kredi biterse, bagli degilse (Orva) bu kutuphaneden secer. Seviye: VO'nun yaklasik 20 dB altinda (loudnorm I=-36 LUFS, VO -16 LUFS).
format: mp3 stereo 44.1 kHz 96 kbps, 75 sn, basta/sonda kisa fade. Dongu icin tools/video ffmpeg -stream_loop kullanir; 60 sn'den uzun video gerekmez.
source: ElevenLabs Music (eleven_music_v2), Doğukan'ın hesabı, 2026-11-27. Telifsiz ticari kullanim: ElevenLabs plan kosullarina bagli.

tech.label: Teknoloji / lansman, minimal elektronik
tech.use: model duyurusu, urun lansmani, AI araci, kodlama
tech.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Tech and AI product launch background music: minimal modern electronic, soft warm synth pads, gentle plucked arpeggio, light steady pulse, calm and confident, seamless loop-friendly with consistent energy, no big drops, about 75 seconds
